description: This is the main class implementation for Zend_Validate, which manages a chain of validators, performs validation checks, and handles related validation messages within the Zend Framework validation component.

classes.name: Zend_Validate
classes.description: Main validator chain class implementing Zend_Validate_Interface, managing multiple validators, executing validations, and providing message handling within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the validation chain with an optional flag to break on failure.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Executes the chain of validators against a value, returns true if all pass.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves validation failure messages collected during validation.

methods.name: getDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the default namespaces for validation classes.

methods.name: setDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Sets new default namespaces for validation classes.

methods.name: hasDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Checks if default namespaces are set.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Dynamically loads and instantiates a validator class by basename and validates a value.

methods.name: getMessageLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum message length for validation messages.

methods.name: setMessageLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum message length for validation messages.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Gets the default translation object for validation messages.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Sets the default translation object for validation messages.
